purpose: Carry forward from the start of the fresh V5H judge run two already accepted structured-output format repairs so known serialization-only failures do not interrupt the frozen semantic_relevance_v0.29.0-r5 measurement instrument.

normalizations.name: duplicate_stage_a_candidate_id_normalization
normalizations.rule: When EvidenceSelection.evidence_span_ids contains duplicate real S# IDs and contains no NONE, remove exact duplicates preserving first-occurrence order, then invoke the original frozen normalize_candidate_span_ids validator.

normalizations.name: prominence_span_echo_normalization
normalizations.rule: Preserve an already-valid S# ID unchanged. Otherwise, replace an item only when its trimmed value exactly equals one supplied rendered source line '<valid S#>: <exact span text>'. Any other malformed/unknown value remains unchanged and is rejected by the original frozen validator.
